sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Blob-Carrying Block Production
sub_graphs.description: Models the validator's block production flow including blob sidecar construction and distribution

nodes.label: Validator Selected as Proposer
nodes.description: Validator has been selected as block proposer for the current slot

nodes.label: Prepare Execution Payload
nodes.description: Send PayloadAttributes including parent_beacon_block_root to execution engine to begin payload construction

nodes.label: Execution Payload Building
nodes.description: Execution engine is constructing the payload with blob transactions

nodes.label: Retrieve Payload and BlobsBundle
nodes.description: Call get_payload on execution engine to receive execution_payload, block_value, and blobs_bundle (commitments, proofs, blobs)

nodes.label: Payload and Blobs Received
nodes.description: Validator has received the full GetPayloadResponse containing execution payload and blobs bundle

nodes.label: Assemble Beacon Block Body
nodes.description: Assign blob_kzg_commitments from blobs_bundle.commitments to block body

nodes.label: Construct BlobSidecars
nodes.description: For each blob, create a BlobSidecar with index, blob data, kzg_commitment, kzg_proof, signed_block_header, and kzg_commitment_inclusion_proof

nodes.label: Block and Sidecars Ready
nodes.description: Signed block and all blob sidecars are assembled and ready for broadcast

nodes.label: Broadcast BlobSidecars to Subnets
nodes.description: Distribute each sidecar to subnet_id = blob_index % BLOB_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT

nodes.label: Sidecars Distributed on Network
nodes.description: All blob sidecars have been published to their respective subnets

external_entities.name: Execution Engine
external_entities.description: Execution layer client that constructs payloads and provides blobs_bundle via Engine API

sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Blob Sidecar Validation and Integrity
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation steps for blob sidecars including KZG commitment verification and inclusion proofs

nodes.label: BlobSidecar Received from Network
nodes.description: A blob sidecar has been received from a gossip subnet

nodes.label: Validate Blob Index
nodes.description: Verify blob index is within MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK bounds

nodes.label: Validate KZG Proof Against Commitment
nodes.description: Verify that the blob data matches the KZG commitment using the provided KZG proof

nodes.label: Validate KZG Commitment Inclusion Proof
nodes.description: Verify the Merkle inclusion proof that the KZG commitment is in the block body

nodes.label: BlobSidecar Validated
nodes.description: Sidecar has passed all validation checks

nodes.label: BlobSidecar Rejected
nodes.description: Sidecar failed validation and is discarded

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Another validator or node broadcasting blob sidecars on gossip subnets

sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Blob Data Availability and Retention
sub_graphs.description: Models the validator's obligations for storing and serving blob sidecars for data availability

nodes.label: BlobSidecar Stored Locally
nodes.description: Validated blob sidecar has been stored for the retention period

nodes.label: Serve Blob Sidecar Sync Request
nodes.description: Respond to peer requests for blob sidecars within the retention window

nodes.label: Check Retention Period Expiry
nodes.description: Determine if MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs have passed since the sidecar's slot

nodes.label: BlobSidecar Retention Expired
nodes.description: Sidecar has exceeded the retention period and may be pruned

nodes.label: Prune Expired BlobSidecar
nodes.description: Remove expired blob sidecar from local storage

external_entities.name: Syncing Peer
external_entities.description: A peer node requesting blob sidecars for historical sync

ambiguities.text: Sidecars may be pruned after MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume pruning is optional but that nodes MUST serve sidecars within the retention window. After expiry, serving is best-effort. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: No explicit ordering requirement between broadcasting the signed block and its blob sidecars
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the block should be broadcast before or simultaneously with sidecars, as receivers need the block header to validate sidecar inclusion proofs. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine is trusted to return correct and consistent blobs_bundle data matching the execution payload
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Validator could broadcast invalid blob sidecars with mismatched KZG commitments, leading to block rejection and potential slashing

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient subnet connectivity exists for blob sidecar propagation across all BLOB_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT subnets
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Blob sidecars may not reach all validators, causing data availability failures and missed attestations
